title: fix(plugin-list): filter candidates read the declared displayField, and no list-column options (objectui#10545, objectui#10547)
body:
Fixes #10545
Fixes #10547
Clause-②: no

One claim for two cards on one branch: objectui#10547 is folded into objectui#10545 (its triage: 「Same file as #10545: serial, or one claim」). There is one commit per card and one changeset.

## What changed

**objectui#10545**, commit `0814660`:

- `ListView`, the `objectDef.fields` branch of the filter/sort candidate builder (`candidateFields`): the candidate reads `displayField: field.displayField` and nothing else. It no longer reads `display_field`, `reference_field` or `id_field`, and the candidate carries no `idField`.
- `UserFilters`, `resolveFields`: reads `displayField = fieldDef.displayField` and nothing else. The `idField` thread is gone (the local, the returned member, the internal `ResolvedField` member and the prop handed to `LookupValuePicker`), because its only writer was the `id_field` read.
- The objectui#7642 census KEEP comments at both sites are replaced. The new comments say what the code reads now and why, and cite this card.

**objectui#10547**, commit `61ce977`:

- `ListView`, the `!objectDef?.fields` columns-only fallback of the same builder: no longer reads `options: buildOptions(fieldName, f.options)` off a list column. Select options reach the candidate from the object definition once it loads. This reuses the objectui#7531 ruling (`5809501335`, letter "remove").

**One changeset**, `.changeset/10545-filter-candidates-displayfield.md`: `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-list`, with one paragraph per card. It says plainly that a def carrying only the refused `display_field` (or only `reference_field`) no longer sets the picker's display field, that `id_field` no longer re-keys the picker, and that a list column's `options` is no longer read.

Two merges of `origin/main` (`1336ba8`, `f0930bb`). The first one (`1336ba8`) picked up this seat's objectui#10597, which touches `ListView.tsx` in a different region. Neither merge had conflicts.

## The contract, re-measured on the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0

`FieldSchema.safeParse` of a lookup def (name, `type: 'lookup'`, label, `reference`) plus one key:

| key | result |
|---|---|
| none (control) | success |
| `zzz_not_a_real_key` (control) | `unrecognized_keys`, no hint |
| `displayField` | **success** |
| `display_field` | `unrecognized_keys`: "Did you mean `display_field` → `displayField`?" |
| `reference_field` | `unrecognized_keys`: "Did you mean `reference_field` → `referenceVia`?" |
| `id_field` | `unrecognized_keys`, no hint |
| `idField` | `unrecognized_keys`, no hint |

`ListColumnSchema.safeParse` of a column (`field`, `label`, `type: 'select'`): the bare column → success; a nonsense key → `unrecognized_keys`; with `options` → `unrecognized_keys`: "Unrecognized key(s) on this list column: `options`." There is no rename hint. The declared keys are `field,label,width,align,hidden,sortable,resizable,wrap,type,pinned,summary,prefix,link,action`.

The pins restate the refusals as lit-control assertions, so the next spec bump re-derives them.

## Why the display read can be `displayField` alone

- It matches `plugin-grid`. `RELATIONAL_META_READ_SET` in `relationalMetaKeys.ts` classifies `displayField` as `spec`, and it is the only display spelling the grid's copy set (`RELATIONAL_META_KEYS`, via `applyRelationalMeta`) reads off a def (objectui#7155). `reference_field` is `no-producer` there and is not copied. So these two sites are no stricter and no looser than the grid's reader.
- A stored pre-strict `display_field` still arrives as `displayField` when it comes through the in-repo serve paths. `normalizeSchemaReferenceKeys` folds it once at ingestion (objectui#7650), in `ObjectStackAdapter.getObjectSchema` and in the `MetadataProvider` object paths. Its alias probe maps `display_field` to `displayField`. `reference_field` and `id_field` probe onto no declared key, so the fold leaves them on the document and logs a dev-mode `no-declared-twin` warning (objectui#8938). That is the one condition the objectui#7642 PM ruling set for any consumer-side retirement in this family, and it now holds.
- A def that reaches these sites some other way (a host `DataSource` that bypasses the adapter, or an `objectDef` passed straight to the exported `UserFilters`) is held to the same `FieldSchema` contract (AGENTS.md 0.1). The changeset says so.

## What the sibling `idField` read becomes: removed, not re-pointed

- `FieldSchema` declares no id column for a lookup: it refuses both `id_field` and `idField`, measured above. So the read targeted no declared key, and re-pointing it to `idField` would put a new read on an undeclared spelling. The same reasoning is recorded at `ObjectChart` and `resolveActionParams`.
- The consumer is `LookupValuePicker` (`@object-ui/components`). It resolves identity with `field.idField || "id"`, then `r.id ?? r._id`. Without the read it always keys by `id`. On a spec-compliant def the read was always undefined, so nothing changes there.
- Producers of `id_field` on an object def: no non-test hit in objectui. In objectstack `origin/main` the only hits are the liveness ledger note, tests, and the unreleased `FIELD_KEY_GUIDANCE` row in `authoring-key-lint.ts`, which says: "`id_field` was never a FieldSchema key: a lookup stores the referenced record's id … the picker resolves record identity itself."
- It matches the grid: the grid's copy set copies no id column, and no grid consumer reads `id_field`.
- `UserFilterFieldSchema` (the view's own `userFilters.fields` entry) declares only `field,label,type,options,showCount,defaultValues`, and it refuses `idField` too. So removing `ResolvedField.idField` drops no authored value.

## Pins, and the before/after

- `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.declaredDisplayField-10545.test.tsx`: the candidate FilterBuilder receives once the definition loads (5 tests).
- `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/UserFilters.declaredDisplayField-10545.test.tsx`: the toolbar lookup picker's resolved label, and the `$filter` key of its label lookup (5 tests).
- `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.columnsOnlyOptions-10547.test.tsx`: the columns-only candidate before load, plus the lit control where options arrive with the definition (3 tests).

Each ablation leg was run under the shared verify lock. It checks out the BASE version of each source file with the pins unchanged, proves on disk that the swap landed (`grep -c` of the pre-fix and post-fix lines), and restores with `git checkout HEAD --`. The restore is proved by an empty `git diff HEAD` and by blob hashes equal to HEAD's, inside an `EXIT INT TERM` trap.

- objectui#10545, at `0814660`, sources at `f169a03`:
  - HEAD: `PINS_HEAD_EXIT=0`, 10 passed (10).
  - BASE: `PINS_BASE_EXIT=1`, 8 failed and 2 passed (10). The 2 that pass are the spec lit-control test and the picker-default control.
  - Messages on BASE:
    - "expected undefined to be 'full_name'" (the positive pin);
    - "expected 'full_name' to be undefined" (the `display_field` and `reference_field` negative legs);
    - "expected 'code' to be undefined" (`id_field`);
    - "Expected: "Ada Lovelace" Received: "ada"" (the picker's positive pin);
    - "expected 'a1' not to be 'a1'" (`id_field` re-keyed the lookup, so the label never resolved).
- objectui#10547, at `f0930bb`, `ListView.tsx` at `1336ba8`:
  - HEAD: `PIN10547_HEAD_EXIT=0`, 3 passed (3).
  - Pre-fix: `PIN10547_PREFIX_EXIT=1`, 1 failed and 2 passed. The failing test is "a column carrying `options` offers the same candidates as a plain one": "expected [ …(2) ] to be undefined". The spec test and the lit control stay green in both legs.

## Gates, at `f0930bb` (the last commit)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-list/` (lock): exit 0, `Test Files 97 passed (97)`, `Tests 1144 passed (1144)`.
- `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/plugin-list --concurrency=2` (lock): exit 0.
  - The log echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, then `Tasks: 14 successful, 14 total`.
  - `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists all 3 new pin files.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`: all exit 0. The line-citation gate printed "VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)".
- Added by re-derivation from `.github/workflows/`: `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, and the `check-changeset-presence` / `-no-major` / `-fixed` / `-overwrite` scripts. All exit 0. Presence printed "5 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)".
- eslint, plain form, on the 5 changed source and test files: exit 0, 0 errors.
  - This is a measured narrowing, not a skip. ① The population is from eslint's own config: `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']` covers all 5. ② `--format json` reports 5 files. ③ The config enables no type-aware linting (`projectService` / `parserOptions.project` count 0), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
  - The warnings (183 on `ListView.tsx`, 30 on `UserFilters.tsx`) equal the same files at BASE. The new test files have 0.
- The full `pnpm lint`, full `pnpm test` and the other workflows are CI's. There was no browser run. The pins render the real `ListView`, `UserFilters` and `LookupValuePicker` under happy-dom.

## Acceptance notes

- class b, handed to the seat, not filed here: `plugin-form` `deriveMasterDetail` (`deriveColumns` and `hydrateColumns`) still reads `d?.display_field || d?.reference_field` and never the declared `displayField`. This is the same seam, at a site this card does not claim. It is a source reading on this tree, not probed. `Seam: spec:FieldSchema.displayField → renderer:plugin-form deriveColumns / hydrateColumns (GridColumn.displayField)`.
- `@object-ui/fields` `LookupField` and `LookupCellRenderer` still read `reference_field` as a second display leg (graded `no-producer` in the grid's register). Not touched; no carrier.
- `ObjectChart` and `resolveActionParams` keep the `display_field` / `reference_field` legs behind `displayField` (objectui#7435). The tree now holds two dispositions for the same refused spellings; this card follows the grid's. No carrier.
- The pending, empty-frontmatter census record `.changeset/lucky-donkeys-shave.md` (objectui#7642) describes both plugin-list sites as KEEP. This PR supersedes that for these two sites. The file declares no package, so it publishes into no CHANGELOG. It is not edited here.
- In the same `candidateFields` memo, the older objectui#6837 note beside `referenceTo` still says the columns-only branch "is NOT narrowed". objectui#7531 and objectui#10547 have since narrowed it. Not edited (outside the claimed lines); no carrier.
